CREATE TABLE "public"."accountDeletionRequest" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "scheduledAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DELETION_REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "verifiedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "accountDeletionRequest_status_check_1bd1a63f" CHECK ("status" IN ('DELETION_REQUESTED', 'VERIFICATION_REQUIRED', 'VERIFIED', 'SCHEDULED', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditLog" (
  "action" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45),
  "metadata" json,
  "resource" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "resourceId" text,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."blockedIp" (
  "blockedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "blockedById" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45) NOT NULL,
  "isPermanent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."blockedUser" (
  "blockedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "blockedById" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPermanent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."company" (
  "code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "logoUrl" text,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dataCorrectionRequest" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "field" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "requestedValue" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewNote" text,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "dataCorrectionRequest_status_check_a234c327" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dataExportJob" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "downloadUrl" text,
  "errorMsg" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "failedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "dataExportJob_status_check_98b77f75" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."department" (
  "code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "divisionId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."designation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "level" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."division" (
  "code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."employee" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dateOfBirth" date,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "departmentId" text,
  "designationId" text,
  "displayName" character varying(200),
  "divisionId" text,
  "employeeCode" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "firstName" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joiningDate" date NOT NULL,
  "lastName" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text,
  "profilePicUrl" text,
  "sectionId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "employee_gender_check_30490488" CHECK ("gender" IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "employee_status_check_b659d8fc" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'RESIGNED', 'TERMINATED', 'EXITED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."location" (
  "address" text,
  "code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loginAttempt" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text,
  "failureReason" character varying(200),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45),
  "success" bool NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text,
  "usernameAttempted" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."permission" (
  "action" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resource" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."privacyConsent" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45),
  "policyId" text NOT NULL,
  "policyVersion" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACCEPTED' NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "privacyConsent_status_check_4bb60351" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACCEPTED', 'DECLINED', 'REVOKED', 'REQUIRED_REACCEPTANCE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."privacyPolicy" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text,
  "effectiveAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "policyType" text NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "version" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "privacyPolicy_policyType_check_1dd55dc5" CHECK ("policyType" IN ('PRIVACY_POLICY', 'TERMS_OF_USE', 'COOKIE_POLICY', 'DATA_RETENTION_POLICY', 'SECURITY_POLICY')),
  CONSTRAINT "privacyPolicy_status_check_bc64f66b" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."privacyRequest" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "requestType" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewNote" text,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "privacyRequest_requestType_check_03338f7e" CHECK ("requestType" IN ('ACCESS', 'EXPORT', 'CORRECTION', 'DELETION', 'PRIVACY_QUESTION')),
  CONSTRAINT "privacyRequest_status_check_a234c327" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."retentionPolicy" (
  "anonymizationBehavior" character varying(50),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataCategory" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "deletionBehavior" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "retentionBasis" text,
  "retentionDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isSystem" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rolePermission" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "permissionId" text NOT NULL,
  "roleId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."section" (
  "code" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."securityEvent" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45),
  "metadata" json,
  "severity" text DEFAULT 'LOW' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "securityEvent_eventType_check_a5f10ed0" CHECK ("eventType" IN ('LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'SESSION_CREATED', 'SESSION_REVOKED', 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'PASSWORD_RESET', 'OTP_REQUESTED', 'OTP_FAILED', 'ACCOUNT_BLOCKED', 'ACCOUNT_UNBLOCKED', 'IP_BLOCKED', 'IP_UNBLOCKED', 'ROLE_CHANGED', 'PERMISSION_CHANGED', 'DEVICE_REGISTERED', 'DEVICE_BLOCKED', 'SUSPICIOUS_LOGIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "securityEvent_severity_check_5e5a5e80" CHECK ("severity" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "email" character varying(200),
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,
  "passwordChangedAt" timestamptz,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(20),
  "phoneVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "username" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_status_check_e2443336" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'BLOCKED', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userDevice" (
  "appVersion" character varying(50),
  "deviceToken" text NOT NULL,
  "firstSeenAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isBlocked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "model" character varying(100),
  "osVersion" character varying(50),
  "platform" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "pushToken" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userRole" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "roleId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userSession" (
  "appVersion" character varying(50),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(45),
  "lastActivityAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "logoutAt" timestamptz,
  "refreshTokenHash" text,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "sessionTokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "userSession_status_check_02f846a1" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'REVOKED', 'LOGGED_OUT'))
)
